differences: The OSF project states no license; the paper itself is CC BY 4.0. The paper's Table 1 counts (243 speech-only, 732 gesture-only and 327 multimodal attempts, 1302 in all) do not reproduce from the deposit: the hand-checked modality file has 71 speech-only, 254 gesture-only and 734 speech-and-gesture rounds (1059 in all), and the paper does not say how it counted attempts.

Speech-intensity analysis: the deposit gives 687 rounds with speech and an intensity from 44 pairs (paper: 243 + 327 = 570 attempts); the 8-talker effect reproduces (0.28 dB against 0.29 dB) but the 4-talker contrast is 0.11 dB here. The paper's submovement ratios (1.142 and 1.093 times clear) come from Poisson mixed models and were not reproduced.
